lines.lyric_hangul: I know every life's a movie
lines.lyric_translation: I know / Every life’s a movie

lines.lyric: We got different start and stories
lines.lyric_hangul: We got different stars and stories
lines.lyric_translation: We got different stars and stories

lines.lyric: We got different nights and mornings
lines.lyric_hangul: We got different nights and mornings
lines.lyric_translation: We got different nights and mornings

lines.lyric_hangul: Our scenarios ain't just boring
lines.lyric_translation: Our scenarios ain’t just boring

lines.lyric_hangul: 나는 이 영화가 너무 재밌어
lines.lyric_translation: I find this movie very amusing

lines.lyric_hangul: 매일매일 잘 찍고 싶어
lines.lyric_translation: Everyday, I want to shoot it well

lines.lyric_hangul: 난 날 쓰다듬어주고 싶어
lines.lyric_translation: I want to caress myself

lines.lyric_hangul: 날 쓰다듬어주고 싶어
lines.lyric_translation: I want to caress myself

lines.lyric_hangul: 근데 말야 가끔 나는 내가 너무너무 미워
lines.lyric_translation: But you know, sometimes I / really really hate myself

lines.lyric: Sasil kkwaena jaju naneun naega neomu miwo
lines.lyric_hangul: 사실, 꽤나 자주 나는 내가 너무 미워
lines.lyric_translation: To be honest, quite often, I really hate myself

lines.lyric: Naega neomu miul ttae nan ttukseome wa
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 너무 미울 때 난 뚝섬에 와
lines.lyric_translation: When I really hate myself, I go to Dduksum

lines.lyric_hangul: 그냥 서 있어 익숙한 어둠과
lines.lyric_translation: I just stand there with the familiar darkness

lines.lyric_hangul: 웃고 있는 사람들과, 나를 웃게 하는 beer
lines.lyric_translation: With the people that are smiling and beer, / Which makes me smile

lines.lyric: Seulmyeosi dagawaseo naui soneul japneun fear
lines.lyric_hangul: 슬며시 다가와서, 나의 손을 잡는 fear
lines.lyric_translation: Coming to me softly, fear, which holds my hand

lines.lyric_hangul: 괜찮아 다 둘셋이니까
lines.lyric_translation: It’s okay because everyone is in twos or threes

lines.lyric_hangul: 나도 친구가 있음 좋잖아
lines.lyric_translation: It’d be nice if I had friends too

lines.lyric_hangul: 세상은 절망의 또 다른 이름
lines.lyric_translation: The world is just another name for despair

lines.lyric: Naui kineun jiguui tto dareun jireum
lines.lyric_hangul: 나의 키는 지구의 또 다른 지름
lines.lyric_translation: My height is just another diameter for the earth

lines.lyric_hangul: 나는 나의 모든 기쁨이자 시름
lines.lyric_translation: I am all of my joy and anxiety

lines.lyric: Maeil banbokdwae nal hyanghan johgo silheum
lines.lyric_hangul: 매일 반복돼, 날 향한 좋고 싫음
lines.lyric_translation: It repeats everyday, the love and hate directed to me

lines.lyric_hangul: 저기 한강을 보는 친구야
lines.lyric_translation: Hey you, who’s looking over the Han River

lines.lyric_hangul: 우리 옷깃을 스치면, 인연이 될까?
lines.lyric_translation: If we bump into each other while passing, would it be fate?

lines.lyric_hangul: 아니, 우리 전생에 스쳤을지 몰라
lines.lyric_translation: Or maybe we bumped into each other in our past life

lines.lyric_hangul: 어쩜 수없이 부딪혔을지도 몰라
lines.lyric_translation: Maybe we bumped into each other countless times

lines.lyric_hangul: 어둠 속에서 사람들은 낮보다 행복해 보이네
lines.lyric_translation: In the darkness, / People look happier than the day

lines.lyric_hangul: 다들 자기가 있을 곳을 아는데, 나만 하릴없이 걷네
lines.lyric_translation: Everyone else knows where they’re supposed to be / But only I walk without purpose

lines.lyric: Geuraedo yeogi seokkyeoitneun ge deo pyeonhae
lines.lyric_hangul: 그래도, 여기 섞여있는 게 더 편해
lines.lyric_translation: But still, blending in with them is more comfortable

lines.lyric_hangul: 밤을 삼킨 뚝섬은 나에게 전혀 다른 세상을 건네
lines.lyric_translation: Dduksum, which has swallowed up the night / Hands me an entirely different world

lines.lyric_hangul: 나는 자유롭고 싶다
lines.lyric_translation: I want to be free

lines.lyric_hangul: 자유에게서 자유롭고 싶다
lines.lyric_translation: I want to be free from freedom

lines.lyric_hangul: 지금은 행복한데, 불행하니까
lines.lyric_translation: Because right now I’m happy but I’m unhappy

lines.lyric_hangul: 나는 나를 보네 뚝섬에서, yeah
lines.lyric_translation: I’m looking at myself / At Dduksum
